title: fix: derive prompt agent catalog metadata
author: Circuit-Overtime
pr_body_excerpt:
- Inherits base-model input modalities for managed prompt agents while reporting chat text output.
- Derives `pollinations_models` and `web_search` capabilities from enabled MCP servers.
- Deduplicates inherited and agent-specific capabilities.
- Adds the Pollinations tools capability and icon to the Models UI.

Floret content-array compatibility was split into #14308.

Addresses #14162.

gist.headline: The agents found their labels
gist.blurb: Managed prompt agents now inherit the useful bits from their base models instead of arriving at the catalog wearing a blank name tag. Their tools, search powers, and chat output are finally visible where people look for them.
gist.summary: Managed prompt agents now inherit base-model input modalities, report chat text output, derive pollinations_models and web_search capabilities from enabled MCP servers, deduplicate capabilities, and show the Pollinations tools icon in the Models UI.
gist.impact: Users browsing models can now see the correct modalities and available Pollinations tools, web search, and model-access capabilities for managed prompt agents before using them.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli as a careful catalog librarian adding clear capability badges to a cozy shelf of managed prompt-agent seed packets. A friendly CRT monitor robot can hold glowing tool, search, and model icons while small code-plants connect the agents to their inherited base-model roots, making the metadata relationship visible.
gist.image_prompt: A cozy pixel art model catalog garden where Polli, the cute yellow-and-brown striped bee mascot with pink blush, light blue wings, and tiny librarian glasses, carefully attaches glowing capability badges to prompt-agent seed packets growing from shared base-model roots; a cheerful CRT monitor robot holds little tool, magnifying-glass, and model icons beside a lime green (#ecf874) terminal. Cozy 8-bit pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with pixel flowers and code-plants, subtle CRT glow, and pixel-font text reading “TOOLS + SEARCH”. Nostalgic but beautiful, emotionally warm.
